summary: Comprehensive implementation plan addressing all 5 user-reported visual and interaction issues: (1) Clean text-free resort background photography on the Login Page and TV Guest App, (2) Single-viewport (100dvh zero-scroll) Login Page on both Desktop and Mobile, (3) Dedicated active states and distinct views for all 14 Sidebar navigation items, (4) Always-visible Close (✕) button and viewport-fitted layout for the TV Guest App Preview modal, and (5) Fixed sidebar footer with independent, ultra-thin luxury scrollbars for the sidebar menu and main workspace content.
